articles.summary: MIDLAND, Texas – Permian Resources Corporation (NYSE: PR) (“Permian Resources,” “we,” “us,” “our” or the “Company”) today announced a corporate reorganization pursuant to which Permian Resources’ management team members and other long-term holders are exchanging their Class C shares for Class A shares. articles.title: Permian Resources Announces Corporate Reorganization to Further Strengthen Its Best-In-Class Shareholder Alignment and Advance Towards Up-C Simplification
